entities.name: Jadwiga Marko-Książek
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jadwiga Książek was a Polish volleyball player, a member of Poland women's national volleyball team in 1959–1969, a bronze medalist of the Olympic Games, a bronze medalist of the World Championship 1962 and silver medalist of the European Championship 1963, three-time Polish Champion.
